title: Affine frequency character
statement: Let $V$ be a subspace of the binary cube, let $a$ be a binary cube vector, and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on that cube. The function $f$ is an affine frequency character associated with $V$ and $a$ if it equals the sign character of some frequency in the affine subspace determined by $V$ and $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $V$ of the binary cube
A sign-valued function on the binary cube
caveat: The definition of the affine subspace determined by $V$ and $a$ is not included in the supplied definitions, so its precise meaning cannot be rendered from the payload alone.
